subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - Acme Financial
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jane Sullivan <jane.sullivan@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - Acme Financial

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through the demo. Really enjoyed learning more about Acme Financial's use case for customer support triage and automated KYC summarization. Per our conversation, I’m attaching a short proposed POC plan so your team can see the recommended scope, success criteria, and timeline. High-level recap below: 

What we demoed
- Redwood hosted inference for chat + extractive summarization
- Streaming responses and tool-calling for KYC lookup flows
- Embeddings for semantic search over support tickets

Proposed POC objectives (90% of success = go/no-go)
1) Accuracy: Model extracts key KYC fields (name, DOB, ID type) with >= 95% precision on a 200-record test set
2) Latency: Average tail latency (p95) for single-record extract < 350ms in our hosted environment
3) Ops: Integration with your S3 bucket and ability to run daily ingest jobs without errors

Proposed timeline (target 4 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, access + test data swap, SOC2/security Q&A
- Week 1: Integration & sample ingest, baseline eval on 50 records
- Week 2: Run full 200-record eval, tune prompts/quantization profile
- Week 3: Final evaluation, handoff + next-steps (dedicated trial or production plan)

Owner roles
- Camila (Redwood): POC PM, point contact for logistics and model config
- Marissa (Redwood): Solutions engineer for integration and prompt tuning
- Dylan (Redwood): Security/compliance follow-up (SOC2 evidence)
- Jane / Acme: Data owner, will provide sample records and test criteria

Attachments: 20270302-Acme-POC-Plan.pdf (POC plan + eval template)

Next steps
1) Can you confirm the proposed success criteria above or suggest edits?
2) Please share the initial test sample (or a link) and a preferred time for a 30-min kickoff this week.
3) We’ll also share a short SOC2 summary for your security team to review (attached).

If that looks good I can send a calendar invite for the kickoff — I’m available Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jane Sullivan <jane.sullivan@acmefinancial.com>

Cc: Acme Financial - IT Security <security@acmefinancial.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 18:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - Acme Financial

Thanks Camila — great demo and helpful plan. A few quick notes from our side after syncing with IT Security and the product team:

- Success criteria: the accuracy target looks reasonable, but can we change the precision threshold to >= 93% (we need to be conservative for an initial trial)? Also add a secondary quality metric for "field completeness" (>= 98% non-empty fields).
- Timeline: 4 weeks is fine but we’d prefer kickoff Thursday if possible (same week).
- SOC2: our security team wants a short summary (scope: production vs. non-production) and a list of evidence items (logs, retention, incident response).

I’ve added security to CC. Please send the updated plan and a kickoff invite for Thu 3/4 at 11:00 AM ET if that works.

Best,
Jane
Jane Sullivan
Senior Product Manager, Acme Financial
jane.sullivan@acmefinancial.com

Thanks —
Camila
